test_frozenlist_immutable_operations: test FrozenList raises TypeError on mutable operations like setitem, delitem, extend, pop, remove, and insert
test_frozenlist_slicing: test FrozenList slicing returns a new FrozenList instance preserving the element values
test_frozenlist_addition: test FrozenList concatenation with tuples and lists using + and += operators
test_frozenlist_union: test FrozenList union method returns a new FrozenList with combined elements
test_frozenlist_difference: test FrozenList difference method returns a new FrozenList with specified elements removed
